name: Jin Dynasty
description: The Jin Dynasty emerges as a formidable military power in northern China. Mounted Villagers move swiftly to claim new resources and land. Seize opportunities and rally hosts of cavalry at a moment's notice to rout enemies and crush opposition. Bribe weak-willed enemies into desertion and establish profitable Tributary States.
descriptionCN: 金朝是中国北方崛起的一股强大军事力量。乡骑移动速度非常快，能够抢先夺取新的资源和土地。抓住机遇，随时集结大量骑兵击溃敌军并粉碎反抗力量。收买意志薄弱的敌军逃兵，并建立起收入可观的进贡国。

overview.title: Civilization Bonuses
list: Train up to 20 Mounted Villagers, which gather and move significantly faster than a standard villager.
Select from three locations upon age up to build a Grassland.
Build War Stables near Grasslands to quickly produce Cavalry with Horses.
Emissaries can Establish Tributaries and Bribe enemy soldiers.
Tributaries generate Food, improve Trader income by +15%, and increase Mounted Villager build limit by +3.
Meng'an Mouke emplacements call upon defenders to protect nearby land.
Bed Crossbows are available in Feudal Age, replacing Springalds.

overview.title: Grasslands
overview.description: Select from 3 locations upon completing a Landmark to build Grasslands, which gradually spawn up to 5 Horses in their field. Horses increase the health of all Melee Cavalry units by +2 and all Ranged Cavalry by +1, or can be used by Stables within the Influence of the Grasslands to quickly train any mounted unit. Grasslands produce a new Horse every 75/60/45 seconds in the Feudal/Castle/Imperial Ages.

overview.title: Jurchen Legacy
overview.description: Nomadic ancestry allows up to 20 Mounted Villagers which gather, construct, and move significantly faster but cost more. Establish Tributary States with Trade Posts to increase the maximum build limit by +3.

overview.title: Meng'an Mouke
overview.description: Upgrade defensive structures with the Meng'an Mouke Emplacements, which send out defenders to protect nearby lands. Emplacements also slowly produce defenders to replenish losses.

overview.title: Emissaries
overview.description:
Train up to 2 Emissaries which come equipped with two powerful abilities.
Establish Tributaries on Neutral Trade Settlements to gain a loyal ally, which will gather food on your behalf, increases Mounted Villager build limit by +3, and increases your traders income by +15%.
Cast Bribe on groups of enemy units, turning foes into neutral fighters who will combat anything in their way.

overview.title: Siege Expertise
overview.description: Build the Machine Workshop in Feudal Age granting early access to Bed Crossbows, a springald replacement which fires two projectiles into enemy formations. Bed Crossbow Emplacements replace Springald Emplacements at all defensive structures.

overview.title: Unique Units
list: Mounted Villager - Unique villager that gathers, builds, and moves significantly faster than a standard villager.
Emissary - Support unit which can bribe enemy soldiers and establish Tributary States.
Iron Pagoda - Heavy Cavalry encased from head to toe in armor, deals area damage on every attack.
Bed Crossbow - Springald replacement that fires a volley of projectiles at once, available in the Feudal Age.
Eruptor - Expensive Handcannon replacement that deals high single target damage.
Mohe Tribesman - Mounted archer replacement. Exceptional at hit and run tactics against light melee infantry.
Zhanma Swordsman - Armored Infantry available only in Imperial Age, deals impressive melee damage with bonus against cavalry.
Meng'an Mouke Defenders - Meng'an Mouke & Mounted Grenadiers spawn from unique emplacements to automatically defend Jin territory.

overviewCN.title: 文明加成
list: 最多可训练 20 名乡骑，他们的采集和移动速度比标准村民快得多。
每当进入新时代，从三个位置中进行选择即可开始建造草原。
在草原附近建造战争马厩，可使用马匹快速生产骑兵。
使者可建立进贡关系和收买敌方士兵。
进贡国可提供食物、使商人收入 +15%，使乡骑的建造上限 +3。
猛安谋克据点可召集守军来保护附近土地。
进入封建时代后可解锁弓床弩，能取代扭力弩炮。

overviewCN.title: 草原
overviewCN.description: 完成地标后，可从 3 个位置中进行选择来建造草原，草原会逐渐在田地里生成最多 5 匹马。马匹可使所有近战骑兵单位的生命值 +2，使所有远程骑兵的生命值 +1，或者可由草原影响范围内的马厩用来快速训练任何骑马单位。在封建/城堡/帝王时代，草原每隔 75/60/45 秒产生一匹新马。

overviewCN.title: 女真遗产
overviewCN.description: 游牧世系最多允许生产 20 的乡骑，其采集、建造和移动速度大幅提升，但成本也更高。建立进贡国并设立贸易站，可将最大建造上限提升 +3。

overviewCN.title: 猛安谋克
overviewCN.description: 使用猛安谋克据点升级防御建筑，可派出守军保护附近的土地。此外，据点还能缓慢地产生守军，补充损失的兵力。

overviewCN.title: 使者
overviewCN.description:
最多可训练 2 个拥有两种强大技能的使者。
在中立贸易聚落建立进贡关系，可获得忠诚的盟友，盟友能代表你采集食物，使乡骑的建造上限 +3，商人的收入 +15%。
成群收买敌方单位，将敌人变成中立战士，他们能攻击挡在前面的任何目标。

overviewCN.title: 攻城专精
overviewCN.description: 在封建时代建造机械车间，可提前获得弓床弩——扭力弩炮的替代升级款，可同时发射两枚投射物攻击敌阵。弓床弩位置取代所有防御建筑的扭力弩炮炮台。

overviewCN.title: 独特单位
list: 乡骑 - 采集、建造和移动速度都比标准村民快得多的独特村民。
使者 - 辅助单位，可收买敌方士兵和建立进贡国。
铁浮屠 - 全身披甲的重装骑兵，每次攻击时造成范围伤害。
弓床弩 - 扭力弩炮的替代单位，能一次发射一连串箭矢，进入封建时代后解锁。
爆破手 - 昂贵手铳的替代单位，可对单个目标造成高伤害。
靺鞨族人 - 骑射手的替代单位。非常善于利用游击突袭战术对付轻型近战步兵。
斩马刀 - 只能在帝王时代解锁的装甲步兵，可造成相当高的近战伤害，且对抗骑兵时有伤害加成。
猛安谋克守军 - 从独特据点生成的猛安谋克和骑马掷弹兵，可自动守卫金朝领土。
